title: 6.25.2 Sub-build: Send and receive one number
description: Two tabs, one room, one number at a time. Every number sent, yours too, arrives in the same order on both.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: The top says Press H to host. H and SPACE do nothing yet. (Before you host or join, `online.code` and `online.seat` hold nothing, so the top shows the hint instead of them.)

steps.title: Listen for moves
steps.instructions: In `setup()`, set up `online.onMove((move, seat) => { got.push(seat + ':' + move.n); });`. Below it, join a room when there is a code: `if (JOIN !== '') online.join(JOIN);`.
hints: `onMove` goes in `setup()`: it is set once, and then runs for every move.

steps.title: Host and send
steps.instructions: In `draw()`, `if (kb.presses('h') && online.status === 'off') online.host();`, and `if (kb.presses('space') && online.status === 'ready') online.send({ n: floor(random(1, 100)) });`. Run, press H, and read the room code at the top.
hints: Sending before the room is `'ready'` stops with an error that says so.

steps.title: Try it with two tabs
steps.instructions: Open this lesson in a second browser tab. Put the code in `JOIN` there and Run. Both tabs now say `ready`. Press SPACE in either one: the same list of numbers grows in both, in the same order, and your own numbers arrive too.
hints: You must be signed in and in a class. A seat is your account in one tab, so each tab gets its own seat.

requirements.title: Moves are received
requirements.description: online.onMove is given a function that runs for every move. Help: 6.25.1 (Reading: One list of moves, two computers)

requirements.title: A move is sent
requirements.description: online.send sends a move. Help: 6.25.1 (Reading: One list of moves, two computers)

requirements.title: Host or join
requirements.description: The sketch hosts a room or joins one. Help: 6.25.1 (Reading: One list of moves, two computers)

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a moSHion sketch for "Sub-build: Send and receive one number". The task: set up online.onMove once to record every move that arrives, host a room on a key or join one from a code, and send a small move like { n: number } when the room is ready. Accept any names, helpers, ternaries and semicolons; a line only in a comment or string does not count. Short, plain notes for a 14-year-old; never write corrected code.

rubric.title: Receives moves
rubric.description: onMove is set up with a function.

rubric.title: Sends a move
rubric.description: online.send is called with a small move.
